subject: Billing contact activation & delivery route for Acme Health - next steps
messages:
From: Mary Jones <mary.jones@acmehealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap-team@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Billing setup question - delivery + billing contact

Hi Ava / Kimberly,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. We're ready to finalize how Acme Health will receive invoices from Redwood. A couple of quick items so we can map this in our AP system: 

- Preferred delivery: we'd like to use a supplier portal if possible, but need a short transition plan (email copies while portal onboarding completes).
- Billing contact: who should we add as the "bill-to"/remit contact in our system? We need name, email, and entity/VAT ID.
- PO mapping: we create PO numbers at the job level; can Redwood populate a PO field on the invoice or include it in the PDF metadata?

Also, can you confirm what VAT evidence you need from us (certificate vs. VAT ID only)? We need to get this to our tax team.

Thanks,
Mary Jones
Accounts Payable Manager
Acme Health

---

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Mary Jones <mary.jones@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 11:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Billing setup question - delivery + billing contact

Hi Mary — thanks, this is great. Short answers and a proposed plan below.

1) Delivery route: portal-first. We can enable Acme's AP email copies while you onboard (two-week window typical). During the transition invoices are posted to the portal and a PDF copy is sent to the AP email. After onboarding we flip to portal-primary with emailed copies by exception.

2) Billing contact / remit: please add the following to your system for now:
   - Redwood Inference (entity for invoices)
   - Billing contact: Ava Chen, billing@redwood.com
   - VAT / Tax ID: US EIN 47-1234567 (we will request your VAT/evidence in reply)

3) PO mapping: we can populate a "Customer PO" field in the invoice metadata and include the PO on the PDF header. If you need it embedded in XML/UBL payloads we can also provide that as part of a portal webhook.

VAT evidence: for EU customers we require VAT certificate; for US customers a tax ID is sufficient. If you have a brokered entity or reverse-charge scenario, please send the VAT certificate so our tax team can tag the invoices.

Attached: ap-onboarding-checklist.pdf (basic portal steps) and vat-evidence-guidance.pdf (what we need from buyers).

Plan (two-week ramp):
- Day 0: Enable portal access + push first invoice to portal; send AP email copy. (Owner: Ava)
- Day 3: Confirm PO mapping works for two sample invoices. (Owner: Connor)
- Day 7-10: AP confirms portal receipt & VAT evidence collected (Owner: Acme AP)
- Day 14: Flip to portal-primary and close email-copy window (Owner: Ava)

If that works, I'll send a small DocuSign for portal account acceptance and confirm the onboarding slot.

Best,
Ava Chen
Sr. Sales Ops (Billing Lead)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ap-onboarding-checklist.pdf, vat-evidence-guidance.pdf

---

From: Mary Jones <mary.jones@acmehealth.com>

Cc: AP Team <ap-team@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 13:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Billing setup question - delivery + billing contact

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear plan. Portal-first with a two-week email-copy grace period sounds perfect. A few clarifications from AP: 

- We'll need the portal to allow us to pull a CSV of invoice line items for our ERP (can you confirm export formats?).
- PO field: please include a single-line PO field that appears both in the portal CSV export and the PDF header.
- VAT evidence: we are in the US but have a UK subsidiary that handles some services; I'll scan and share their VAT certificate to the email thread if needed.

Please go ahead with the DocuSign and we'll sign.

Thanks,
Mary

- Billing contact: Redwood to be added as the invoice originator, Ava (billing@redwood.com) as the billing contact for remit questions.
